final: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_d FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_d) AS m FROM p) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_d) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(p.avg_d / o.m) AS avg_ratio FROM p, o WHERE p.SEX <> '' AND p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX
